summary: community.aws cloudfront_distribution deprecates the items return value in trusted_signers, aliases and cache_behaviors sub-fields (removal after 2026-12-15) in favor of elements.
questions: Why is the items key deprecated in cloudfront_distribution results?
What replaces items in cloudfront_distribution aliases output?

answer_card.title: cloudfront_distribution items → elements (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md: In `community.aws.cloudfront_distribution`, the `items` return value is deprecated in favor of **`elements`** (removed in a release after **2026-12-15**). Affected fields include `active_trusted_signers`, `aliases`, and under `cache_behaviors.items`: `allowed_methods`, `allowed_methods.cached_methods`, `forwarded_values.cookies.whitelisted_names`, `forwarded_values.headers` and `forwarded_values.query_string_cache_keys`.
